subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 3: Grammar – Comparative and superlative adjectives
outcomes: I can make comparatives and superlatives: big – bigger – the biggest.
I can use more / the most with long adjectives and know good and bad forms.
I can compare people and things using than and the.

tf.s: The comparative of big is bigger.
tf.why: Yes! big → bigger: we double the g.

tf.s: The superlative of good is the goodest.
tf.why: Good is irregular: good – better – the best.

tf.s: We use more with long adjectives: more hard-working.
tf.why: Right! Long adjectives use more and the most.

tf.s: "She is the most short girl in the class" is correct.
tf.why: Short is a short adjective: the shortest.

tf.s: The comparative of bad is worse.
We use than after a comparative: taller than.
tf.why: Great! Ali is taller than Saif.
Yes! the biggest, the best, the most hard-working.

tf.s: The comparative of curly is curlyer.
Kind is a long adjective, so we say more kind.
tf.why: Kind is short: kinder, the kindest.

tf.s: "You're the biggest cat ever!" has a comparative.

boxes.why: With than we use the comparative.

boxes.q: Rahaf is ___ than me at schoolwork. (good)

boxes.why: y changes to i, then add -er.

boxes.q: Basil is the ___ boy in the whole school. (bad)
This film is ___ than that film. It's very boring. (bad)
He is the ___ person in my family. (hard-working)
boxes.why: Long adjective + superlative: the most hard-working.

boxes.q: She always gets ___ marks than me.

o: good – more good – the most good

mcq.q: How do long adjectives make the superlative?
Which word do we use after a comparative?
What is the comparative of tidy?
Ali is 140 cm, Saif is 135 cm and Omar is 150 cm. Which sentence is true?
mcq.why: 150 is the biggest number, so Omar is the tallest.

o: Is Zainab more tidier than Hazim?

mcq.q: Why do we say "more hard-working" but "kinder"?
o: Hard-working is long; kind is short.
mcq.why: Long adjectives use more; short ones add -er.

mcq.q: Find the mistake: "Hazim is more tidy than Zainab."
o: It should be the most tidy.
mcq.why: Tidy is a short adjective: tidier.

mcq.q: A mouse, a cat and a wolf. Which sentence is correct?
o: The cat is bigger than the wolf.
The mouse is bigger than the cat.
mcq.why: A wolf is bigger than a cat, and a cat is bigger than a mouse.
